labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Something is broken.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: Agreed work to build or change.

labels.name: type:decision
labels.description: A choice the owner needs to make before work can go ahead.

labels.name: type:experiment
labels.description: Try something small and measure it before committing.

labels.name: type:docs
labels.description: Documentation only.

labels.name: type:tooling
labels.description: CI, tests, build scripts, refactors and how-we-work changes.

labels.name: area:agents
labels.description: Models, prompts, memories, personality, skills, families and conversations.

labels.name: area:towns
labels.description: Buildings, households, land, work, trade and crafting.

labels.name: area:world
labels.description: Map generation, terrain, weather, plants, survival and time.

labels.name: area:saves
labels.description: Saving, loading, replay and recovery.

labels.name: area:interface
labels.description: Godot screens, controls and art.

labels.name: area:server
labels.description: Host, pairing, keys, deployment and the Windows package.

labels.name: area:tooling
labels.description: CI, tests, build scripts and repository setup.

labels.name: status:needs-decision
labels.description: Waiting on the owner's answer.

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Waiting on something its description names: another issue, a pull request or an outside event.

labels.name: status:needs-pr
labels.description: Agreed and unblocked; needs someone to pick it up and open a pull request.

labels.name: status:in-progress
labels.description: An issue claimed by someone working on it. Reviewers claim pull requests with status:reviewing.

labels.name: status:has-pr
labels.description: An open pull request closes this issue (Closes, Fixes or Resolves). Added automatically.

labels.name: status:needs-review
labels.description: Pull request is ready and waiting for review. Added automatically.

labels.name: status:reviewing
labels.description: A reviewer has claimed this pull request; other reviewers skip it.

labels.name: status:merging
labels.description: Taking its turn to merge: in its final CI run on current main. Others wait to merge.

labels.name: status:parked
labels.description: Closed for now; agreed work for a later stage. Search closed issues to find it again.

labels.name: owner-task
labels.description: Work only computment can do, such as a repository setting or key. Playtest checks go in playtest/.

labels.name: owner-priority
labels.description: The owner chose this priority in chat; nobody else moves it.

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Broken now (crash, lost saves or keys, security, can't play) or a how-we-work change. Do first.

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: Next up: hurts normal play, or needed for the next playtest.

labels.name: priority:p2
labels.description: Normal: agreed features and ordinary bugs. The default.

labels.name: priority:p3
labels.description: Polish: cosmetic issues, edge cases and nice-to-haves.

labels.name: accessibility
labels.description: A barrier for players with disabilities.

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Something that used to work broke.

labels.name: from:playtest
labels.description: Found while playing the game.
